analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by capacity expansion and a strategic shift towards value-added coated steel products such as Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel. The company crossed the Rs 1,000 Crore revenue milestone, achieving substantial growth in EBITDA and profit after tax while maintaining a conservative debt profile. Management outlined forward revenue targets of Rs 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and Rs 3,000 Crore by FY 2028-29, backed by ongoing capacity additions and backward integration initiatives. Manaksia Steels Limited is implementing capital expansion projects including a new Alu-Zinc line and a colour coating line to transition into a specialised value-added flat steel manufacturer. For FY 2024-25, the company reported revenues of H584.18 Crore, EBITDA of H25.69 Crore, and PAT of H11.70 Crore.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's revenues reported a marginal decline of 1.48% when compared with the previous year, coming in at H631.96 Cr.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company reported H631.96 Cr in revenues during FY 2023-24, a marginal decline of 1.48% when compared with the previous year.
